description: This module manages STONITH in a Pacemaker cluster using the Pacemaker CLI.

parameters.name: agent_validation
parameters.description: Enabled agent validation for STONITH creation. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specify the STONITH name to create.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state for cluster STONITH. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "enabled" "disabled"

parameters.name: stonith_metas
parameters.description: List of metadata to associate with STONITH.

parameters.name: stonith_operations
parameters.description: List of operations to associate with STONITH. Default: []

parameters.name: stonith_options
parameters.description: Specify the STONITH option to create. Default: []

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Timeout period for polling the STONITH creation. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Create virtual-ip STONITH
  community.general.pacemaker_stonith:
    state: present
    name: virtual-stonith
    stonith_type: fence_virt
    stonith_options:
      - "pcmk_host_list=f1"
    stonith_operations:
      - operation_action: monitor
        operation_options:
          - "interval=30s"

return_values.name: previous_value
return_values.description: The value of the STONITH before executing the module. Returned: on success Sample: " * virtual-stonith\t(stonith:fence_virt):\t Started"

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: The value of the STONITH after executing the module. Returned: on success Sample: " * virtual-stonith\t(stonith:fence_virt):\t Started"
